name: Implementation Plan

exitCriteria.describe: Every task traces to a requirement.

purpose: Break the approved design into developer-sized tasks that each trace to a requirement.

method.summary: Slice the work, sequence it by dependency, and trace every task to a requirement.
steps: Read the approved design and the acceptance criteria.
Delegate the decomposition to the planning specialist where the slicing is larger than this conversation.
Author one task per developer-sized unit of work.
Sequence the tasks by dependency and trace each to the requirement it fulfils.
Retire a task the design no longer needs with `setLifecycle` rather than deleting it.
Ask the operator to confirm the attestation, record an attestation against each exit criterion, then exit.

nextActivity.rule: Delegate to planning when the decomposition needs specialist work; author or revise while any task is oversized or untraced; attest once every exit criterion holds; exit only after attestation.
constraints: A task no one developer could take on is not sized.
A task that traces to no requirement is not planned work.

approvalBoundary.approves: The task set and its sequencing.
requires: The operator confirms the exact stage attestation or advance through Kiln's interactive confirmation channel during that invocation.

completionSummary.format: A concise Markdown handoff with bullets under Completed, Decisions, Open items, and Next activity.
includes: The tasks and the order they are to be taken in.
